title: Jagged Spring Turkish Lamb Doner Kebab
description: A festive Turkish dish featuring the vibrant flavors of spring, perfect for a light and refreshing meal.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together coriander, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the lamb shoulder in a large bowl and sprinkle the flour over it.
Toss the lamb shoulder to coat it evenly with the flour.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until it is browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook the lamb for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Slice the lamb shoulder into thin strips against the grain.
In a small bowl, mix together the chopped spring onions and parsley.
Serve the lamb doner kebab with the yogurt sauce and garnish with the spring onion and parsley mixture.
